heading: Frequently Asked
Questions
faq.description: Find answers about our jewellery, choosing a piece, and getting in touch with our team.

items.question: How can I check the materials used in a piece?
items.answer: Materials and certifications can vary by design. Contact us with the piece you are interested in and we will share the details available for it.

items.question: Can you help me choose a piece?
items.answer: Tell us who you are shopping for, the occasion, and the style you have in mind, and our team can help you explore the collection.

items.question: Can I ask about a custom design?
items.answer: Contact us with your idea and any reference images. We will let you know whether we can help with your request.

items.question: Where can I find shipping or returns information?
items.answer: Contact us before ordering and we will confirm the current delivery and returns information for your order.

items.question: How should I care for my jewellery?
items.answer: Store pieces separately and keep them away from moisture, perfume, and household chemicals. Use a soft jewellery cloth for gentle cleaning.
